Generate ONE standalone 16:9 horizontal Chinese blog article illustration, landscape approximately 1600 by 900. Use case: illustration-story. This is a new composition for a finance beginner's article using a restaurant chain as its running example.

Pure #FFFFFF white background, minimalist black hand-drawn ink line art with lightly wobbly thin lines; absolutely no paper texture, gradients, shadows, gray wash or background scenery. Lots of negative space: subjects around 50% of canvas, at least 35% blank white area, especially upper and side margins. A few small red/orange/blue handwritten Chinese annotations. Adult deadpan conceptual sketch, never commercial vector art, children's cartoon, cute mascot, PPT, formal flowchart, lesson slide, or polished infographic. No overall title or top-left heading. No panel borders or grid.

Recurring character 小黑: solid black irregular bean-shaped worker, tiny white round dot eyes, thin stick legs and thin arms, completely blank serious expression, no mouth, no costumes, no shiny eyes. Two such workers must be actively performing the core actions, not standing decoratively.

One shared small restaurant at center-left of canvas, a simple hand-drawn building with an awning and the short black sign “饭店”. One 小黑 at its left is on tiptoe lifting its roof straight off like the lid of a lunchbox. The exposed simple interior contains one cooking pot, a tiny table, and one small bookkeeping sheet, no elaborate interior. The worker is carefully peering inside, studying the actual business. A small BLUE handwritten annotation “看经营” next to this action, with a short leader pointing inside.

From the same restaurant's right-side wall, a narrow paper receipt naturally unrolls toward the right and curves gently upward at its far end. This is a PRICE HISTORY chart, not a cashflow tube: on the paper, draw a sparse irregular BLACK candlestick price series with alternating rises and falls and small volume bars beneath. The second 小黑 on the right is seated on a small stool and uses a handheld magnifying glass to examine the candlesticks on this long receipt. A small RED handwritten annotation “看价格” beside the second worker, with a short leader pointing to the paper chart. A tiny orange curl at the turning paper edge can emphasize the physical unrolling; no connecting arrows between the two approaches.

Core idea: fundamental analysis examines the business; technical analysis examines the market's price and volume; both concern the SAME restaurant company. Do not imply a sequence, guaranteed upward prices, profits, or superiority of one method. Keep the two actions visually interconnected through the same restaurant and its chart-paper but airy, asymmetrical, and sparse.

Only three text labels are allowed, exactly: “饭店”, “看经营”, “看价格”. All readable handwritten simplified Chinese. No extra title, explanatory paragraphs, dates, numbers, formulas, captions, labels or watermark. Let the visual actions explain the distinction.

Generate ONE new standalone 16:9 landscape Chinese blog article illustration, approximately 1600 by 900. Use case: illustration-story. This is the companion image to a pure-white black-ink minimalist finance article illustration.

Pure #FFFFFF white background. Sparse, slightly wobbly black hand-drawn line art. Deadpan adult conceptual humor. At least 40% empty white space. Main drawing occupies about half the canvas with generous margins. Only tiny restrained blue/red/orange handwritten accents, no coloring large surfaces. No gradients, shadows, texture, gray background, vector polish, commercial cartoon, cute mascot, children's illustration, PPT slide, formal diagram, flowchart, panel grid, overall title, top-left heading, watermark or framing border.

One core meaning: an index fund determines what the investor buys; regular fixed-amount investing determines how money is added over time. This is a metaphor for buying fund shares, NOT financing or paying the underlying companies directly; no guaranteed gains, no growing money tree, no upward investment-return curve.

One 小黑 performs the essential action. 小黑 is an irregular solid-black bean-shaped creature with two tiny white dot eyes, thin stick arms and legs, a blank serious expression, no mouth or costume. It is perched on a small step inside a comically oversized freestanding flip calendar as if the calendar were its tiny workstation. A few overlapping blank calendar sheets suggest passing months, but do not write dates, numerals or month names. The calendar has only the small black handwritten word “每月” at its top, naturally part of the object, not a page title. It should be clear that this is a calendar, not a theater or machine diagram: simple two binding loops on top and a loose grid of date squares.

The worker is carefully tipping one sturdy, visibly fixed-size measuring scoop full of simple outlined coins into a small shopping basket placed immediately to its right. The scoop is the focus of the action. Three or four coins are falling from the scoop into the basket. Small RED handwritten note “固定金额” near the scoop with one short leader. A tiny orange motion stroke by the tipping scoop, no large arrow.

In the basket are three oversized stock certificates, each with one simple different business icon (a restaurant awning, a factory roof, and a computer monitor); use black line drawing and no text on the certificates. The basket is broad enough that all three certificates are clearly visible. Its front has the short BLUE handwritten label “指数基金”. Do not show coins going separately to the businesses. Keep the basket and calendar in one shared physical scene, asymmetrical and airy, not separate comparison panels. A few loose outlined coins in a shallow bowl beside the calendar provide the worker's source of money, no other props.

Only permitted text, exactly and once each: “每月”, “固定金额”, “指数基金”. All simplified Chinese, readable handwritten lettering. Do not add titles, explanatory captions, numbers, extra labels, slogans, profits, tables or diagrams. This should look like an inventive hand-drawn marginal illustration for an adult essay, visually clear in a single glance.
